info.title: skl Training API
info.description: Local FastAPI contract for the scikit-learn-client platform. ONNX is the required training artefact.

get.description:
Report the worker queue against its configured concurrency limit.

The counters come straight from the ``jobs`` table: ``runningJobs`` counts
the non-terminal statuses, so a slot is only reported busy while an attempt
is actually in flight. This makes "why is my job still queued?" answerable
without reading the process logs.
Return the allow-listed algorithm catalogue, optionally filtered by task type.

post.description:
Accept a CSV upload, persist bytes, hash, and infer column preview.

The extension, the declared content type, and the sniffed bytes are all
checked before anything is written to the volume.

get.description: Return dataset metadata and column preview.

Return the per-column profile of a dataset plus a raw preview.

The profile is computed once at upload time; the preview rows are read
from the stored CSV on demand.

List jobs with optional filters, sorting, and cursor pagination.

Filters compose with AND. ``status``, ``taskType``, ``algorithmId``, and
``tag`` take comma-separated values; ``tag`` requires **all** the listed
tags to be present.

post.description:
Validate and enqueue a training job. Returns 202 Accepted.

When an ``Idempotency-Key`` header is supplied, the response is cached and
replayed on retry (see :mod:`src.api.idempotency`).

get.description: Compare 2–5 jobs side by side, with warnings about unlike jobs.

get.summary: Download the artefacts of several jobs as a ZIP bundle
get.description: Bundle the artefacts of 1–10 jobs into one ZIP archive.
Return the current state of a job.

patch.description:
Update the human-readable metadata of a job.

Only ``name`` and ``tags`` are editable; the training configuration of a
job is immutable. A field that is absent from the request is left
unchanged.

delete.description: Delete a job and its artefact files.

get.summary: Download the artefacts of one job as a ZIP bundle
get.description: Bundle the artefacts of one job into a ZIP archive.
Stream an artefact file as an attachment.
Identify the service and its version.
